name: Veluza
description: Veluza, the Jettison Pokémon. A Water and Psychic type.
pokedex_entries: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.
Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.
